items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I mean he used to watch Billy Gladstone and all these great drummers in the pits at Radio City

ctx.x: He was pretty self taught musically, wasn’t he?

Yeah. I think he’s one of those guys who were the creators. You know two thousand years ago people sat at the foot of someone, you know, the mentor. And you absorbed and you studied in the real world of institutions and university studying. But it wasn’t about, you know, go change your schedule so biology is Tuesday and Thursday. So I think, yeah, he was self taught but he created. I mean he used to watch Billy Gladstone and all these great drummers in the pits at Radio City and, you know, he sat and

absorbed. And he also had, all the ingredients were right. The quick wit, the great talent, the genetic and physiological capabilities, the great ear. Just all the ingredients were strong. It’s like a great athlete that has it all. You know I remember reading about Schwarzenegger, when he was a world class body builder. But he was on the like championship soccer teams over in Europe. And genetically he was together, but he was a great athlete. So I think when you have all of those strong ingredients you go far.…
